places.name: Kansas
places.note: A day short of Dodge, Dan spots Wilbarger driving horses south and turns the gang to rob him; Dan scoffs that no Kansas lawman can take him.

places.name: Arkansas River
places.note: Following Wilbarger's trail northwest, the gang swims it by moonlight without pausing.

places.name: Wilbarger's night camp north of the Arkansas
places.note: Night raid kills Chick and a young wrangler; Wilbarger escapes wounded, Frog Lip is gut-shot and finished off by Eddie.
places.location_hint: on open plain a few hours' ride north of the Arkansas River, reached by tracking northwest at night from near Dodge City

places.raw_name: a tent under a single tree
places.name: Settlers' tent under a lone tree
places.note: Dan murders two plowing farmers, then hangs and burns their bodies from the only tree and takes their mules.
places.location_hint: open Kansas plain about two hours' ride north of Wilbarger's camp, north of the Arkansas River

places.name: Dodge City
places.note: Only a day away; Jake longs for its barber and whores and hopes to slip the gang there, but they veer off.

places.name: Abilene
places.note: Dan first proposes selling the stolen horses there, then heads the other way.

places.name: Denver
places.note: Dan guesses Wilbarger has more herds headed there.

places.name: Texas
places.note: Roy wonders if Wilbarger is taking the horses back there.

places.name: Mexico
places.note: Jake recalls the outfit returning Wilbarger's horses, taken from Pedro Flores, out of there.

places.name: Arkansas
places.note: Jake dates his bad luck to accidentally shooting the dentist there.

places.name: Nebraska
places.note: Dan says he fancies seeing it, driving the stolen herd north.

places.name: St. Louis
places.note: Jake dreams of escaping there and taking a boat downriver.

places.name: New Orleans
places.note: One gamblers' town Jake imagines fleeing to.

places.name: New York
places.note: Another gamblers' town Jake imagines fleeing to.

places.name: Mississippi River
places.note: Jake vows not to stop until he reaches it if he escapes.

groups.label: Jake with the Suggs gang
groups.hint: driving about twenty-five stolen horses and two mules north across Kansas, north of the Arkansas River, toward Nebraska
